statement: 'hotpotqa_clean' is the name of the LEGACY experimental substrate (507,494 nodes, the HotpotQA DISTRACTOR-setting context union), not of a dataset. canonical_v1 uses the clean dataset name 'hotpotqa' for its directory, exactly as it does for 2wiki / musique / squad. There is now exactly ONE live directory for this dataset.

Its content was MOVED here (nothing deleted) and the now-empty directory was removed, so no two live directories exist for one dataset. The migrated file is status.json in this directory.
